storeListing.title: Rasoi: Aaj Kya Banaye? Recipes
storeListing.shortDescription: Aaj kya banaye? Cook from your pantry. 1,200+ Indian recipes. 15 cuisines.
storeListing.fullDescription:
Rasoi helps Indian home cooks answer "Aaj kya banaye?" every evening — decide dinner in seconds from what's already in your kitchen.

🍳 TONIGHT'S PICKS
• Smart meal suggestions for breakfast, lunch, dinner & late-night
• Personalized picks based on your diet and regional cuisine

🥘 COOK FROM YOUR PANTRY
• Add pantry items and see recipe match %
• Filter recipes you can cook right now

📚 1,200+ INDIAN RECIPES
• 15 regional cuisines — Gujarati, South Indian, Punjabi, Bengali & more
• Veg, Jain, Egg & Non-Veg filters
• Quick filters: under 20 min, leftovers, kids-friendly

🛒 SHOP & ORDER (Rasoi Plus)
• Open Blinkit, Zepto & Instamart for missing groceries
• Zomato & Swiggy delivery when you want to order instead

⭐ RASOI PLUS SUBSCRIPTION
• Monthly ₹49 or Yearly ₹499 (save 15% vs monthly)
• Ad-free experience across the app
• Partner grocery & delivery checkout links
• Cancel anytime in Google Play → Subscriptions

🆓 FREE TO START
• Free plan with recipes & pantry matching
• Optional 3-day in-app trial for partner features (managed in-app, not a Play free trial)

Rasoi may use your city (optional location permission) for local recipe relevance and sponsor analytics.

Website: https://rasoiapplication.in
Privacy: https://rasoiapplication.in/privacy
Terms: https://rasoiapplication.in/terms
Support: cooking@rasoiapplication.in
